sections.description: Sends all WordPress mail through your own SMTP server, logs every message, and lets you preview or resend it.
sections.changelog:
1.5.1

  • Fix saving the Cloudflare Turnstile site and secret keys.

1.5.0

  • Admin reorganised into Dashboard, Mail, Email log, Bot protection and Security log screens.
  • New Dashboard with status and shortcuts to Cloudflare and WordPress pages.

1.5.0

  • Admin reorganised into Dashboard, Mail, Email log, Bot protection and Security log screens.
  • New Dashboard with status and shortcuts to Cloudflare and WordPress pages.

1.4.1

  • Add a Check for updates link to the plugin's row on the Plugins screen.

1.4.0

  • Cloudflare Turnstile bot and spam protection for login, registration, lost-password, comments, WooCommerce and Contact Form 7.
  • Comments blocked with no exceptions when enabled.
  • New Security tab with verified/blocked analytics and an opt-in debug log.

1.3.0

  • Optionally file a copy of each sent message in the mailbox's Sent folder over IMAP.
  • Sent folder detected automatically, with a manual override.

1.2.0

  • Renamed to Helo, with a new menu icon.
  • Email log is now a two-pane mail client view.
  • Existing settings and logs are adopted automatically.

1.1.0

  • Redesigned admin screens.
  • Self-hosted updates.

1.0.0

  • First release.
